import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train/train.json"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test/test.json"
SUB_PATH = "./input/sampleSubmission.csv"
OUT_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        return pd.DataFrame(json.load(f))


print("Loading data...")
train_df = load_json(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = load_json(TEST_PATH)

# Target variable
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)


# Text feature engineering
def combine_text(df):
    title = df["request_title"].fillna("")
    body = df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    return title + " " + body


train_df["full_text"] = combine_text(train_df)
test_df["full_text"] = combine_text(test_df)

tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    sublinear_tf=True, max_features=5000, stop_words="english", min_df=2
)
tfidf.fit(train_df["full_text"])
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.transform(train_df["full_text"])
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["full_text"])

# Numerical features
num_feats = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
]

for feat in num_feats:
    train_df[feat] = train_df[feat].fillna(0)
    test_df[feat] = test_df[feat].fillna(0)

# Log-transform positively skewed features
log_feats = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
]

for feat in log_feats:
    train_df[feat] = np.log1p(np.maximum(train_df[feat], 0))
    test_df[feat] = np.log1p(np.maximum(test_df[feat], 0))


# Temporal features
def extract_time_features(df):
    dt = pd.to_datetime(df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s", errors="coerce")
    df["hour"] = dt.dt.hour.fillna(12)
    df["dayofweek"] = dt.dt.dayofweek.fillna(3)
    return df


train_df = extract_time_features(train_df)
test_df = extract_time_features(test_df)

# Stack numerical and temporal features
time_feats = ["hour", "dayofweek"]
X_train_num = csr_matrix(train_df[num_feats + time_feats].values)
X_test_num = csr_matrix(test_df[num_feats + time_feats].values)

# Combine tabular and textual features
X_train = hstack([X_train_num, X_train_tfidf])
X_test = hstack([X_test_num, X_test_tfidf])

# Stratified train/validation split
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(y_train)), test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

X_tr, y_tr = X_train[train_idx], y_train.iloc[train_idx]
X_val, y_val = X_train[val_idx], y_train.iloc[val_idx]

# LightGBM configuration
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

print("Training model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(
    X_tr,
    y_tr,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False)],
)

# Validate on held-out set
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set using the trained model
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Save submission
sub_df = pd.read_csv(SUB_PATH)
sub_df["requester_received_pizza"] = test_preds
sub_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
